translationRepairs: In the sixth year of Guangxu, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong recruited one thousand sand-dwellers for Humen; Yang Yuken added one thousand men and five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong raised two thousand An braves—all organized as local militia under defensive brave regulations.

In the sixth year of Guangxu, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong recruited one thousand sand-dwellers for Humen; Yang Yuke added one thousand men and five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong raised two thousand An braves—all organized as local militia under defensive brave regulations.
s0191 names 楊玉科; standard pinyin is Yang Yuke, so idiomatic 'Yuken' is a real transliteration error and the proposed replacement is otherwise unchanged and accurate.

Sixth year of Guangxu, Governor-General Zhang Zhidong of the Two Guangs recruited one thousand sand-dwellers to help garrison Humen; Yang Yuken added one thousand and five hundred for the Huiqing Camp; Zheng Shaozhong recruited two thousand An braves—all recruited local militia organized under defensive brave regulations.

The same 楊玉科 appears in the literal field as 'Yang Yuken'; correcting to Yang Yuke fixes the romanization without changing any other meaning.
